scope: Saved four-ply witness replay and five-second discovery, not a full audit
rule: r8: bishop control of the central Black shuffle square behind an interposed knight
geometry: Orthogonal opposition or knight-distance kings; knight immediately in front of White toward Black; Black strictly closer to board midpoint. Among current/adjacent Black squares preserving that geometry, target those nearest the midpoint. Frozen before White moves. Bishop control respects blockers.
